source_columns.names: publisher names from the source contract
source_columns.representation: all non-Boolean values retain decoded source lexemes as Parquet UTF8; is_individual is nullable BOOLEAN
source_columns.ordering: physical leaf order is canonical Parquet schema order and must be resolved by name

added_columns.name: lt_source_row_ordinal
added_columns.meaning: one-based row ordinal in the selected immutable COPY relation

added_columns.name: lt_source_raw_byte_offset
added_columns.meaning: zero-based uncompressed byte offset of the source row

added_columns.name: lt_source_raw_byte_length
added_columns.meaning: source row byte length including the terminating line feed

added_columns.name: lt_normalization_state
added_columns.meaning: valid or invalid typed projection state

added_columns.name: lt_normalization_issue_codes_json
added_columns.meaning: JSON array of stable issue codes; null for a valid projection

added_columns.name: lt_receipt_amount_source_scale
added_columns.meaning: fractional digit count in the source receipt amount lexeme

added_columns.name: lt_aggregate_ytd_minor_units
added_columns.meaning: losslessly parsed signed contributor aggregate USD cents

added_columns.name: lt_aggregate_ytd_source_scale
added_columns.meaning: fractional digit count in the source aggregate lexeme

added_columns.name: lt_receipt_date
added_columns.meaning: calendar date derived from the source local receipt timestamp

added_columns.name: lt_receipt_at_local
added_columns.meaning: source receipt timestamp without invented timezone

added_columns.name: lt_publisher_loaded_at_local
added_columns.meaning: publisher load timestamp without invented timezone

added_columns.name: lt_memoed_subtotal
added_columns.meaning: true exactly when memo_cd equals X; no counting decision

identity.per_row_hashes: derived on demand; not stored as high-cardinality physical columns
